column4: US-101 Software Requirements Specification with measurable NFRs
column5:
As the product owner (supervisor), I want a baselined SRS with measurable quality targets, so that scope, MVP boundary and acceptance can be verified objectively.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given the SRS, when any NFR is read, then it contains a measurable threshold and a verification method
- Given the MVP boundary section, when a feature is proposed, then it can be classified as MVP, advanced or out of scope without discussion
- The supervisor approves SRS v1.0 at the Sprint 1 review and the approval is recorded in the document history

Technical tasks:
- Run a requirements workshop and capture functional requirements as numbered FR-xxx items traced to use cases
- Define NFRs with thresholds - supported inputs (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM; H.264, HEVC, VP9, AV1; AAC, Opus, PCM), max input 30 min / 4 GB for MVP, output H.264/AAC MP4 up to 1080p, processing-time targets, availability
- Specify target platform presets (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with resolution, max duration, safe zones and loudness targets
- Define user roles (Owner, Editor, Viewer, Admin), security boundaries, deployment environment, hardware and storage strategy
- Document the MVP boundary (talking-head, podcast, educational footage) and the explicit out-of-scope list
- `DOC` Publish docs/requirements/srs.md and review it through a pull request with the whole team

Parallelism: Parallel - can start on day 1 of the sprint

column4: US-103 Architecture baseline, module boundaries and ADRs

column4: US-111 Monorepo scaffold with enforced architecture rules
column5:
As a developer, I want a monorepo with consistent tooling and automatically enforced layer rules, so that code quality and Clean Architecture do not depend on memory.

Acceptance criteria:
- On a fresh clone, pnpm install, build and test succeed with one command each
- A commit with lint errors is rejected by the pre-commit hook
- An import from packages/domain to an infrastructure package fails the lint step

- Create pnpm workspaces with Turborepo - apps/web (Next.js), apps/api (NestJS), workers/agent-worker, workers/media-worker, workers/render-worker (Node), workers/ai-worker (Python 3.11 with uv)
- Create packages/domain, packages/schemas, packages/tool-sdk, packages/media-core, packages/shared plus infra/, tests/ and docs/
- Configure strict TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, Ruff and mypy; add husky/lint-staged and pre-commit hooks; enforce Conventional Commits
- Enforce dependency rules with dependency-cruiser (TS) and import-linter (Python) so domain cannot import infrastructure or frameworks
- Add CODEOWNERS per module and a pull request template containing the DoD checklist
- `TEST` Add a deliberately violating fixture that proves the dependency rule fails the lint step

Depends on: US-103
